title: COP31 Puts Children, Youth and Teachers at the Heart of Climate Education
title_zh: COP31关注气候教育：安塔利亚行动协议把儿童、青年和教师放在中心
source_name: ICESCO — “COP31 Presidency Ministerial Session: ICESCO Director-General Stresses Need to Translate Climate Education Commitments into Tangible Impact” (15 Nov 2026); UNESCO, “Education for climate action at COP31”
summary_zh: 据伊斯兰世界教育、科学及文化组织（ICESCO）11月15日报道，以及联合国教科文组织（UNESCO）相关说明，11月14日在土耳其安塔利亚举行的联合国气候大会COP31进入“儿童、青年、教育与技能日”。土耳其国家教育部与UNESCO、经济合作与发展组织（OECD）共同举办高级别部长会议，提出名为“安塔利亚行动协议”的共同议程，强调把儿童、青年和教师放在“绿色教育”的中心。UNESCO“绿色教育伙伴关系”从绿色学校、绿色课程、绿色教师培训和绿色社区四个相互关联的方面支持各国，并聚焦三项优先事项：加强教师职前与在职的气候相关培训、扩大青年对政策与行动的实质参与，以及加强监测与证据，以便各国跟踪进展、相互学习。ICESCO总干事萨利姆·马尔基在循证监测会议上表示，环境教育承诺必须在学校和年轻人的日常生活中产生切实影响；该组织与UNESCO合作推出的“绿色教育进展监测全球仪表板”原型现已汇集近100个国家在上述四个领域的数据。土耳其称自己已成为该伙伴关系的第100个成员；教育部长优素福·特金说，气候变化与可持续性内容已纳入从学前到中学的19门必修课和选修课，部分学校还在“环境友好学校项目”中安装太阳能系统并用收集的雨水浇灌花园。会议还宣布成立监测与证据工作组、青年工作组，并启动将气候与可持续性纳入教师教育的全球指南编制；首份《全球绿色教育状况报告》计划于2030年发布，并有望参考2029年PISA气候素养评估。
paragraphs: On 14 November, education ministers and international officials met in Antalya, Türkiye, during the United Nations climate summit known as COP31. The day was devoted to children, youth, education and skills. A high-level ministerial program, organized by Türkiye's Ministry of National Education together with UNESCO and the OECD, presented a shared agenda called the Antalya Protocol for Action. The aim was to show how schools and teachers can help societies respond to climate change.

The protocol places children, young people and teachers at the heart of "greening education". UNESCO's Greening Education Partnership supports countries in four connected areas: greening schools, greening curriculum, greening teacher training and greening communities. Its three priorities are better climate-related training for teachers before and during their careers, stronger ways for young people to take part in policy and action, and closer monitoring so countries can track progress and learn from one another.

At a session on evidence-based monitoring, Salim M. AlMalik, director-general of the Islamic World Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (ICESCO), said commitments on environmental education must produce a tangible impact in schools and in young people's daily lives. A prototype Global Dashboard for Monitoring Progress in Green Education, developed with UNESCO, now compiles data from nearly 100 countries across those four areas. Measuring progress, he argued, should help prepare future generations to respond to climate change, especially in the communities most vulnerable to its effects.

Türkiye, the host of the summit, said it had become the 100th member of the Partnership. Education Minister Yusuf Tekin told the opening session that climate change and sustainability had been added to 19 compulsory and elective courses, from preschool to secondary school. Under an Environmentally Friendly School Project, some schools have installed solar energy systems and use collected rainwater to irrigate gardens. Laws alone, he argued, cannot change the habits that harm nature; education must also reach the next generation.

Organizers also announced a working group on monitoring and evidence, a youth working group, and the start of global guidance to help countries include climate and sustainability in teacher education. A first Global State of Greening Education Report is planned for 2030 and is expected to draw on a climate literacy assessment in the 2029 PISA study. The message from Antalya is that promises on paper are not enough: classrooms, teachers and students need to be part of the response.
paragraphs_zh: 11月14日，多国教育部长和国际官员在土耳其安塔利亚举行的联合国气候大会COP31期间会面。这一天专门讨论儿童、青年、教育与技能。由土耳其国家教育部与联合国教科文组织（UNESCO）和经济合作与发展组织（OECD）共同组织的一场高级别部长级活动，提出了一项名为“安塔利亚行动协议”的共同议程。其目的是表明，学校和教师可以如何帮助社会应对气候变化。
该协议把儿童、青年和教师放在“绿色教育”的中心。教科文组织的绿色教育伙伴关系从四个相互关联的方面支持各国：绿化学校、绿化课程、绿化教师培训和绿化社区。它的三项优先事项是：在教师入职前和职业生涯中提供更好的气候相关培训；为年轻人参与政策和行动提供更有力的途径；以及加强监测，以便各国跟踪进展并相互学习。
在一场关于循证监测的会议上，伊斯兰世界教育、科学及文化组织（ICESCO）总干事萨利姆·马尔基表示，环境教育方面的承诺必须在学校和年轻人的日常生活中产生切实影响。一个与教科文组织共同开发的“绿色教育进展监测全球仪表板”原型，现已汇集近100个国家在上述四个领域的数据。他指出，衡量进展的目的，应是帮助培养子孙后代应对气候变化，尤其是在最易受其影响的社区。
作为本次峰会的东道国，土耳其表示自己已成为该伙伴关系的第100个成员。教育部长优素福·特金在开幕会议上说，气候变化与可持续性内容已纳入从学前教育到中学的19门必修课和选修课。在“环境友好学校项目”下，一些学校已安装太阳能系统，并用收集来的雨水浇灌花园。他提出，仅靠法律无法改变那些伤害自然的习惯；教育也必须触及下一代。
组织方还宣布成立监测与证据工作组、青年工作组，并启动帮助各国把气候与可持续性纳入教师教育的全球指南编制。首份《全球绿色教育状况报告》计划于2030年发布，并有望参考2029年国际学生评估项目（PISA）中的气候素养评估。安塔利亚传出的信息是：纸面上的承诺还不够，课堂、教师和学生都需要成为应对行动的一部分。

key_words.meaning_zh: adj. 脆弱的；易受伤害的

phrases.meaning_zh: 高级别部长级活动（议程）
绿色教育（使教育体系更关注气候与可持续性）
循证监测；基于证据的监测
切实的影响；看得见的成效
纸面上的承诺；书面承诺

questions.prompt: What is the passage mainly about?
options: A decision by the OECD to cancel the PISA study until 2030.
A new agenda at COP31 that puts children, youth and teachers at the centre of greening education.
A plan by Türkiye to close schools that do not install solar energy systems.
ICESCO's decision to move its headquarters to Antalya during the climate summit.
questions.explanation: 全文主旨是COP31在安塔利亚举行“儿童、青年、教育与技能日”，推出“安塔利亚行动协议”，把儿童、青年和教师放在绿色教育的中心，并介绍监测工具、土耳其的课程实践以及后续工作组和2030年报告。文中并未说OECD取消PISA、土耳其要关闭未安装太阳能的学校，或ICESCO把总部迁到安塔利亚。

evidence.quote: The protocol places children, young people and teachers at the heart of "greening education"

questions.prompt: According to the passage, what does the Global Dashboard for Monitoring Progress in Green Education now do?
options: It compiles data from nearly 100 countries across four areas of greening education.
It replaces all national school exams with a single global climate test.
It provides solar energy systems to every school in Türkiye.
It requires every country to add climate change to 19 university courses.
questions.explanation: 第三段明确写道，这个与UNESCO共同开发的全球仪表板原型“现已汇集近100个国家在上述四个领域的数据”。文中没有说它取代各国考试、为土耳其所有学校提供太阳能，或要求每个国家把气候变化纳入19门大学课程；19门课是土耳其从学前到中学的必修课和选修课。

evidence.quote: now compiles data from nearly 100 countries across those four areas

questions.prompt: What can be inferred about the organisers' view of climate education today?
options: Most countries have already finished greening every school and community.
Young people should stay out of climate policy until the 2030 report is published.
Official commitments have been made, but they have not yet fully changed what happens in classrooms.
Laws and written promises are more effective than teaching the next generation.
questions.explanation: 文章多次暗示：承诺已经提出，但还需要落到学校和日常生活中。ICESCO总干事强调承诺必须产生切实影响；结尾又写道“纸面上的承诺还不够”，课堂、教师和学生需要成为应对行动的一部分。由此可以推断，组织者认为现有官方承诺尚未充分改变课堂里的实际情况。选项A与仍在监测进展、计划2030年发布报告的做法不符；选项B与加强青年参与的优先事项相反；选项D与特金“仅靠法律不够、教育必须触及下一代”的观点相反。

evidence.quote: promises on paper are not enough: classrooms, teachers and students need to be part of the response
